newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.6 Sept 27 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.6 Sept 27 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) fell to 104.6 in the week ended September 27 from a revised 105.1 the previous week, ECRI said.

A drop in the growth rates of industrial materials prices and real estate loans, along with a widening of the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries, contributed to the decline in the inflation gauge, ECRI said.
"The continued easing of the FIG reaffirms that underlying inflation pressures are still benign, and that a cyclical upturn in inflation is not on the horizon," ECRI said.
